# Space Quiz — Project Instructions

## Project Structure

- Keep the project as a single-file web application in `index.html`.
- Use HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript in the same file.
- Avoid external dependencies and frameworks unless explicitly requested.

## Code Quality

- Keep code readable and organized.
- Use clear, descriptive variable and function names.
- Preserve existing quiz behavior when making changes.
- Make the smallest necessary changes to fix a problem.
- Do not add unnecessary files or dependencies.

## Accessibility and Design

- Use semantic HTML where appropriate.
- Maintain visible keyboard focus indicators.
- Support keyboard interaction and reduced-motion preferences.
- Keep the layout responsive on narrow screens.
- Provide clear feedback for correct and incorrect answers.

## Testing

- Test relevant quiz functionality in the browser after changes.
- Verify answer selection, score updates, progress, results, and restart behavior.
- Check keyboard interaction when browser controls allow it.
- Report what was actually tested and distinguish unverified behavior from failures.
- Never claim a test passed unless the result was observed.

## Communication

- Explain important code changes briefly.
- Identify potential risks before changing unrelated functionality.
- Ask for clarification when a requested change is ambiguous.
